XMLDB.COMMENT: NIT AI video assistant: one approved transcript per course module, plus the quiz generation runs written from it.

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_ai_transcripts
TABLE.COMMENT: One transcript per course module. Keyed on cmid, NOT on a video provider, so any activity that can show a video can carry one.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module the transcript belongs to

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning module, e.g. mod_vdocipher. Picks the player adapter.

FIELD.NAME: sourceref
FIELD.COMMENT: Provider video id at approval time. A change means the video was replaced.

FIELD.NAME: sourcelength
FIELD.COMMENT: Video duration in seconds at approval time

FIELD.NAME: format
FIELD.COMMENT: Detected source format: vtt|srt|json|txt

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Detected language: ar|en|mixed|unknown

FIELD.NAME: hasonscreen
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher says the transcript includes on-screen text (code, slides)

FIELD.NAME: lasttimestamp
FIELD.COMMENT: Last cue start in seconds; compared against sourcelength

FIELD.NAME: segments
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of {s,e,t} cues

FIELD.NAME: plaintext
FIELD.COMMENT: Flattened text, used when there are no timestamps

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher ticked 'enable the assistant'

FIELD.NAME: approved
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher reviewed the parse result and approved it

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who uploaded the transcript; they own keeping it up to date

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_ai_quizgen
TABLE.COMMENT: One quiz generation run per attempt. Holds the draft questions between generating them and creating the quiz, and stays afterwards as the link between a quiz and the video it was written from.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module of the video the questions were written from

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who ran the generator

FIELD.NAME: sourceref
FIELD.COMMENT: Provider video id at generation time. A change means the quiz describes a video nobody is watching.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft while the teacher is reviewing, created once the quiz exists

FIELD.NAME: options
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the choices made in the wizard

FIELD.NAME: items
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON holding the generated questions and the blocks declared empty of teachable content

FIELD.NAME: coverage
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: which parts of the video the questions reach, and which they miss

FIELD.NAME: quizcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module of the quiz this run created, 0 while still a draft
